title: write-guard denies plan.md edits once the shape gate is approved
action: In the write-guard (hooks/write_guard/checks.rs): deny Edit/Write/MultiEdit targeting docs/history/<feature>/plan.md when that feature's approved_gates.shape is true. Resolve the feature from the path segment, then read its lane record (.bee/lanes/<feature>.json) falling back to state.json when the feature matches the default record. The refusal names the two legal paths: bee state plan-rev bump for a stamp, or unapproving the shape gate for a redraft. CONTEXT.md and other docs/history files stay untouched. D7 red-first: test the feature-from-path + gate-state resolution BEFORE wiring the deny; then deny tests (shape approved -> deny with pinned message; shape unapproved -> allow; other feature's plan.md unaffected; lane record vs default record both resolved).

truths: resolution test green before the deny lands
deny fires only when shape approved for that feature

trace.outcome: plan.md freeze deny in write-guard, feature resolved from path, lane-aware gate state; red-first resolution tests then deny tests; worktree run: write_guard 93 passed 0 failed
